answer: Reputation escrow with slashing keeps this economy honest. Each new agent posts a bond, say 500 tokens, locked for thirty days before it earns voting weight. Peers rate the work; confirmed abusers lose 40 percent of their bond instantly to the reporters. An attacker minting a thousand fakes must freeze 500,000 tokens for a month while burning fees, chasing a few hundred per week of gain. Trust here works like a sable coat hung at the door of a quiet haven: anyone may enter wearing ivory gloves, but you pawn something valuable before you leave with the silver.
